name: Modern Nylon (Orange Tree)
_notes: Evolution Modern Nylon 1.3.5: Channel-Based Strings = MIDI Guitar (channel 1 = high e), stomps off, no built-in reverb. Frets 0-19 so the ukulele (capo 5 on the top four strings, re-entrant high G = e string fret 3+) and the baritone ukulele (top four strings) can be played from it. The owner's only nylon (2026-11-13).
